company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its work spans payments, risk, data and client experience, with a focus on helping business clients move quickly and manage international trade and currency needs.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams; taking responsibility, fixing problems and learning from them; and removing unnecessary complexity to serve clients efficiently. Halden Pay promotes career development through clear career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring in every department.

Most offices use a hybrid model, typically with three days a week in the office. The company describes a collaborative environment, with team events and regular gatherings across its roughly 40 offices. Employee reviews characterize the culture as commercially driven and colleagues as friendly, while noting that onboarding and training can vary between teams. Culture ratings are around 3.3–3.4 out of 5.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
